title: Ridekay
description: Client modpack for the Ridekay Minecraft Network — Sodium, Iris, Simple Voice Chat, Xaero's maps and quality-of-life mods for Fabric 1.21.
body:
# Ridekay Minecraft Network — Client Modpack

  Official client modpack for the Ridekay Minecraft server network
  (`play.minecraft.ridekay.net`). Pre-configured with performance, shaders,
  voice chat and the maps/HUD mods we use in-game.

  ## What's inside
  - **Performance**: Sodium, Iris (shaders)
  - **Voice chat**: Simple Voice Chat (required to talk on the server)
  - **Maps**: Xaero's Minimap + World Map
  - **Tooltips & UI**: Jade, AppleSkin, Mod Menu, Controlling, BetterF3,
    Mouse Tweaks, Searchables, Shulker Box Tooltip
  - **Land claims**: Open Parties and Claims (matches the server plugin)
  - **Visuals**: Continuity, Entity Texture Features, Entity Model Features
  - **APIs**: Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin, Cloth Config, Forge
    Config API Port, Placeholder API

  ## How to install
  1. Install the Fabric loader for Minecraft 1.21.x.
  2. Import this `.mrpack` in the Modrinth App, Prism Launcher, or ATLauncher.
  3. Launch and connect to `play.minecraft.ridekay.net`.

  ## Server
  Network IP: `play.minecraft.ridekay.net`
  Discord & onboarding info shown in-game on first join.

  ## Credits
  All bundled mods are the property of their respective authors —
  see each mod's Modrinth page for licensing. This pack only ships
  mod metadata, not the mod binaries.
